died.name: Joseph Addison
died.cause: to his stepson, Edward Rich, 7th Earl of Warwick
died.last_words: See in what peace a Christian can die.

died.name: Joseph Warren
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Bunker Hill
died.last_words: I am a dead man: fight on, my brave fellows, for the salvation of your country.

died.name: Selina Hastings, Countess of Huntingdon
died.last_words: My work is done; I have nothing to do but to go to my Father.

died.name: Clement Vallandigham
died.cause: The American politician and lawyer, who was defending a man accused of murder, accidentally shot himself while demonstrating how the victim might have done so. His client was acquitted.

died.name: Nicholas Comper
died.cause: dying in hospital after being knocked down while lighting a firework in Hythe, Kent, by a passer-by to whom he claimed he was an IRA man planning to blow up the town hall The 42-year-old aviator and aircraft designer was attempting to light a firework in Hythe, Kent, when a passerby enquired what he was doing; he replied sarcastically that he was an IRA man planning to blow up the town hall. The passerby responded by knocking down Comper, who hit his head on the curb.
died.last_words: I didn't know prisons had such comfortable beds.

born.name: Edward I of England
born.cause: to his son, Edward II of England, while dying during a war with Scotland
born.last_words: Carry my bones before you on your march, for the rebels will not be able to endure the sight of me, alive or dead.

born.name: John Wesley
born.desc: English cleric and theologian, founder of Methodism
born.last_words: The best of all is, God is with us.

born.name: Red Foley
born.last_words: I'm awful tired now, Hank. I've got to go to bed.
